description.narrative: A more effective, transparent and accountable Security Council able to take effective action to maintain international peace and security, notably in conflict-affected developing countries dominating the Council’s agenda.

SCR’s objective is to advance the transparency and effectiveness of the UN Security Council. This includes making available timely, balanced, high-quality information about the activities of the Council and its subsidiary bodies. SCR also convenes stakeholders to deepen the analysis of issues before the Council and its working methods and performance. In addition, it builds capacity on Council practice and procedure through assisting incoming members and through other support, outreach and educational engagements. SCR is independent and impartial; it advocates transparency but does not take positions on the issues before the Council. The objective of the development cooperation is to contribute to a more transparent, effective and accountable UN Security Council. Better-informed Council members and a more transparent decision-making process helps strengthen Security Council outcomes. In particular, the work of SCR contributes in the domains of protecting vulnerable populations, strengthening democratic institutions, contributing to conflict-resolution and prevention as well as in monitoring UN peacekeeping and peacebuilding efforts. Whereas conflict-affected developing countries take up the vast majority of the Security Council’s agenda, the grant contributes to efforts to maintain stability for the benefit of the populations of those countries.
